patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, featuring large, impactful headings on one side and supporting content or imagery on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
Dominant use of oversized, heavy-weight sans-serif typography for primary headings creates a bold and direct communication style, contrasting with lighter body text.
A vibrant, energetic orange is strategically used as a primary accent color to highlight calls to action and key information against a largely monochromatic white and black background.
Sections and content elements reveal with a subtle fade-up and slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a dynamic and engaging user experience.
Numbered, full-width sections with distinct gradient backgrounds guide the user through a multi-step process, clearly delineating each stage of the service.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using GSAP to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up and slide-in effect as they become visible. The hero section features an auto-playing video. A sticky navigation bar appears after an initial scroll. The circular image gallery uses dynamic positioning and rotation for its elements, likely driven by CSS transforms or GSAP. The footer's dot pattern is an animated visual element.
Utilize a high-contrast color palette with a bright accent color against a clean, spacious layout. Employ large, bold typography for headlines to establish a strong visual hierarchy and impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, heavy sans-serif headings (up to ~6x body size) paired with a clean, lighter-weight sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with most elements having sharp corners, but some interactive elements and image containers feature a slight rounding. The footer has a distinct rounded bottom edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample padding around content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive use of oversized, bold typography combined with a high-energy orange accent color creates a powerful and modern aesthetic. The dynamic, interactive circular image gallery and the animated dot pattern in the footer add a unique, playful touch that elevates it beyond a standard marketing site.
